Open a new worksheet in the same workbook and paste (Ctrl+V). Verify that only the billing lines are present, with no blank rows or payment lines included.

Applying Data Subtotal by supplier - With the cleaned data in the new worksheet, go to Data Subtotal. Configure as follows: At each change in: Descripcion (supplier name column); Use function: Sum; Add subtotal to: column H (billing amount). Click OK. The data will be grouped by supplier with a subtotal row for each. Click outline level 2 to collapse and display only the supplier subtotal rows.
Select the collapsed subtotal rows. Again, use the Visible Cells Only method (Home Find & Select Go To Special Visible Cells Only Copy) to avoid carrying over hidden detail rows.

Populating the check request template - Navigate to the first tab of the workbook (the check request template page) and paste. The template pre-built formulas will automatically match the Citibank supplier names to the correct Oracle supplier names. Manually update the following fields: (1) Payment due date, correct to the appropriate payment date for the current month; (2) Statement/document date, update to the current period; (3) Invoice number, enter the month and year (e.g., JAN2026) as the invoice reference to ensure traceability for historical research.

Saving and sending for approval - Save the completed Excel template. Then save a copy as PDF (File Print PDF format). Attach the Citibank PDF statement received in step 21 to this PDF package so the approver has full visibility of the statement supporting the check request amounts.

Log in to DocuSign. Navigate to Inbox Start Send an Envelope. Upload the completed check request PDF with the Citibank statement attached. Add a title and a brief message to the approver (TBD). Click Next. Place the signature field in the designated approval area. Click Send.

Monitor the DocuSign inbox for the completion notification email confirming that the approver (TBD) has signed. The check request approval process is complete once the DocuSign envelope status shows Completed.
Confirming completion and notifying - Upon receiving the DocuSign completion notification, confirm the signed check request PDF has been saved.
Send an email with the signed PDF attached to TBD, including the comments and the invoice number (e.g., JAN2026).

TBD will reply confirming when the process is completed on their side. The Ghost Card check request process for the month is complete. Note: This process covers Ghost Card only (account ending 8500). Airfare Card and P-Card check requests are handled separately by the designated team member (TBD). Note: This process is to be executed on the first business days of the month, upon receipt of the Citibank statement from TBD.
steps_es: Recepción y verificación del estado de cuenta de Citibank: en los primeros días hábiles del mes, recibe el correo de TBD con dos adjuntos: (1) el archivo Excel de Citibank con todas las líneas de facturación, líneas de pago y líneas informativas de la cuenta maestra Ghost Card; y (2) la copia en PDF de Citibank de la factura oficial. Guarda ambos archivos localmente. Abre el PDF, verifica el monto total a pagar, y confirma que el pago del mes anterior fue reconocido y aplicado por Citibank.

Filtrado del estado de cuenta en Excel: abre el archivo Excel de Citibank. Elimina todos los filtros existentes para ver el conjunto completo de datos antes de aplicar el filtrado requerido en el siguiente paso.

Aplica filtros de Excel para mostrar solo las líneas de facturación de US. Estas son las líneas que contienen el nombre del proveedor (columna Description) y el monto de facturación (columna H) necesarios para la solicitud de cheque. Excluye las líneas de pago y todas las demás líneas informativas. Las filas restantes deben contener solo las entradas de facturación de proveedor relevantes.

NO uses un Ctrl+C estándar para copiar las filas filtradas. En su lugar, usa el método Go To Special: Home, Find & Select, Go To Special, Visible Cells Only, OK, luego Ctrl+C. Abre una nueva hoja en el mismo libro y pega (Ctrl+V). Verifica que solo estén presentes las líneas de facturación, sin filas en blanco ni líneas de pago incluidas.

Aplicando Subtotal de datos por proveedor: con los datos limpios en la nueva hoja, ve a Data, Subtotal. Configura de la siguiente forma: At each change in: Description (columna del nombre del proveedor); Use function: Sum; Add subtotal to: columna H (monto de facturación). Haz clic en OK. Los datos se agruparán por proveedor con una fila de subtotal para cada uno. Haz clic en el nivel de outline 2 para colapsar y mostrar solo las filas de subtotal por proveedor.

Selecciona las filas de subtotal colapsadas. Nuevamente, usa el método Visible Cells Only (Home, Find & Select, Go To Special, Visible Cells Only, Copy) para evitar arrastrar filas de detalle ocultas.

Completando la plantilla de solicitud de cheque: ve a la primera pestaña del libro (la página de plantilla de solicitud de cheque) y pega. Las fórmulas preconstruidas de la plantilla harán coincidir automáticamente los nombres de proveedor de Citibank con los nombres correctos de proveedor en Oracle. Actualiza manualmente los siguientes campos: (1) Payment due date, corrígela a la fecha de pago apropiada para el mes actual; (2) Statement/document date, actualízala al período actual; (3) Invoice number, ingresa el mes y año (por ejemplo, JAN2026) como referencia de la factura para asegurar trazabilidad en investigaciones históricas.

Guardando y enviando para aprobación: guarda la plantilla de Excel completada. Luego guarda una copia como PDF (File, Print, formato PDF). Adjunta el estado de cuenta PDF de Citibank recibido en el paso 21 a este paquete PDF para que el aprobador tenga visibilidad completa del estado de cuenta que respalda los montos de la solicitud de cheque.

Ingresa a DocuSign. Ve a Inbox, Start, Send an Envelope. Carga el PDF de solicitud de cheque completado con el estado de cuenta de Citibank adjunto. Agrega un título y un breve mensaje al aprobador (TBD). Haz clic en Next. Coloca el campo de firma en el área de aprobación designada. Haz clic en Send.

Monitorea el buzón de DocuSign para el correo de notificación de finalización confirmando que el aprobador (TBD) ha firmado. El proceso de aprobación de la solicitud de cheque está completo una vez que el estado del envelope de DocuSign muestre Completed.
Confirmando finalización y notificando: al recibir la notificación de finalización de DocuSign, confirma que el PDF firmado de la solicitud de cheque se haya guardado.
Envía un correo con el PDF firmado adjunto a TBD, incluyendo los comentarios y el número de factura (por ejemplo, JAN2026).

TBD responderá confirmando cuando el proceso se complete de su lado. El proceso de solicitud de cheque Ghost Card del mes está completo. Nota: este proceso cubre solo Ghost Card (cuenta terminada en 8500). Las solicitudes de cheque de Airfare Card y P-Card se manejan por separado por el miembro del equipo designado (TBD). Nota: este proceso debe ejecutarse en los primeros días hábiles del mes, al recibir el estado de cuenta de Citibank de TBD.

workInstructions.title_en: Ghost Card Check Request – Canada Billing Lines
workInstructions.title_es: Solicitud de Cheque Ghost Card – Líneas de Facturación Canadá
workInstructions.objective_en: To establish a standardized monthly process for creating the Ghost Card check request by receiving, filtering, and consolidating Citibank credit card statement data, populating the approved check request template, and obtaining the required management signature via DocuSign prior to payment processing.
workInstructions.objective_es: Establecer un proceso mensual estandarizado para crear la solicitud de cheque Ghost Card mediante la recepción, filtrado y consolidación de los datos del estado de cuenta de la tarjeta de crédito Citibank, completando la plantilla de solicitud de cheque aprobada y obteniendo la aprobación de gerencia requerida.
steps_en: Receive the monthly email from Chandra containing two attachments: (1) the Citibank Excel file --- a detailed breakdown of all billing lines, payment lines, and informational lines for the Ghost Card master account; and (2) the Citibank PDF --- a copy of the official invoice. Save both files locally. Open the PDF and verify the total amount to be paid and confirm that last month's payment was acknowledged and applied by Citibank.

Open the Citibank Excel file sent by Chandra. This file contains the raw statement data including billing lines, payment lines, and informational lines. Remove all existing filters to view the complete data set before applying the required filtering in the next step.

Apply Excel filters to the data. Filter the statement to show only the SGS Canada billing lines, as these are the lines that contain the supplier name ("Descripcion" column) and the billing amount (column H) needed for the check request. Exclude payment lines and all other informational lines --- these are not required. Once filtered, the remaining rows should contain only the relevant supplier billing entries.

Select all the filtered rows. Do NOT use a standard Ctrl+C copy, as this will include all hidden blank and payment lines along with the visible data. Instead, use the Go To Special method: Home Find & Select Go To Special Visible Cells Only OK, then Copy (Ctrl+C). Open a new worksheet within the same workbook and paste (Ctrl+V). Verify that only the SGS Canada billing lines are present in the new sheet, with no blank rows or payment lines included.

With the cleaned data in the new worksheet, go to Data Subtotal. Configure the subtotal with the following settings: At each change in: "Description" (supplier name column); Use function: Sum; Add subtotal to: Column H (Billing Amount). Click OK. The data will be grouped by supplier with a subtotal row for each. Click outline level 2 to collapse the view and display only the supplier subtotal rows. These collapsed subtotals represent the amount owed per supplier and will feed into the check request template.
Select the collapsed subtotal rows. Again, use the Visible Cells Only method (Home Find & Select Go To Special Visible Cells Only Copy) to avoid carrying over hidden detail rows.

Navigate to the first tab of the workbook (the check request template page) and paste. The template's pre-built formulas will automatically match the Citibank supplier names to the correct Oracle supplier names. Note: The template compensates for the known discrepancy between "Grainger" (as shown on the Citibank statement) and "Acklands Grainger" (the name used in Oracle) --- no manual correction is needed for this supplier. Manually update the following fields: (1) Payment due date --- correct to reflect the appropriate payment date for the current month's statement; (2) Statement/document date --- update to the current period; (3) Invoice number --- enter the month and year right after the invoice number (e.g., "JAN2026") as the invoice reference. Using the month and year format ensures easy identification when researching historical payments in the future.

Save the completed Excel template file. Then save a copy as PDF (File Print PDF format). The PDF version is the document that will be sent for approval. Also attach the Citibank PDF statement (received from Chandra in Step 1) to this PDF package, so the approver has full visibility of the statement supporting the check request amounts.

Log in to DocuSign. Navigate to Inbox Start Send an Envelope. Upload the completed check request PDF (with the Citibank statement attached). Add a title and a brief message to the approver (Marcello) the approver receives this request monthly and is familiar with the process. Click Next. Place the signature field in the designated area of the document. Click Send. Monitor the DocuSign inbox for the completion notification email confirming that Marcello has signed. The check request approval process is complete once the DocuSign envelope status shows as Completed.

The approver receives this request monthly and is familiar with the process. Click Next. Place the signature field in the designated area of the document. Click Send. Monitor the DocuSign inbox for the completion notification email confirming that Marcello has signed. The check request approval process is complete once the DocuSign envelope status shows as Completed.
Upon receiving the DocuSign completion notification, confirm the signed check request has been saved.
Send an email with the result PDF signed by Marcello attached to Anjali Garud with the comments and the invoice number.

Anjali will reply back, informing when the process is completed on her side. Note: this process is to be done on the very first Busness days of the month Note: The process Tranferred from wendy is noly for Ghost Cards, Pcards and Airfare Cards process are in charge of Moon Lee.
steps_es: Recibe el correo mensual de Chandra con dos adjuntos: (1) el archivo Excel de Citibank — un desglose detallado de todas las líneas de facturación, líneas de pago y líneas informativas de la cuenta maestra Ghost Card; y (2) el PDF de Citibank — una copia de la factura oficial. Guarda ambos archivos localmente. Abre el PDF y verifica el monto total a pagar, y confirma que el pago del mes anterior fue reconocido y aplicado por Citibank.

Abre el archivo Excel de Citibank enviado por Chandra. Este archivo contiene los datos crudos del estado de cuenta, incluyendo líneas de facturación, líneas de pago y líneas informativas. Elimina todos los filtros existentes para ver el conjunto completo de datos antes de aplicar el filtrado requerido en el siguiente paso.

Aplica filtros de Excel a los datos. Filtra el estado de cuenta para mostrar solo las líneas de facturación de SGS Canadá, ya que estas son las líneas que contienen el nombre del proveedor (columna "Description") y el monto de facturación (columna H) necesarios para la solicitud de cheque. Excluye las líneas de pago y todas las demás líneas informativas — no son necesarias. Una vez filtrado, las filas restantes deben contener solo las entradas de facturación de proveedor relevantes.

Selecciona todas las filas filtradas. NO uses un Ctrl+C estándar, ya que esto incluirá todas las filas ocultas en blanco y de pago junto con los datos visibles. En su lugar, usa el método Go To Special: Home, Find & Select, Go To Special, Visible Cells Only, OK, luego Copy (Ctrl+C). Abre una nueva hoja dentro del mismo libro y pega (Ctrl+V). Verifica que solo estén presentes las líneas de facturación de SGS Canadá en la nueva hoja, sin filas en blanco ni líneas de pago incluidas.

Con los datos limpios en la nueva hoja, ve a Data, Subtotal. Configura el subtotal con los siguientes ajustes: At each change in: "Description" (columna del nombre del proveedor); Use function: Sum; Add subtotal to: columna H (Billing Amount). Haz clic en OK. Los datos se agruparán por proveedor con una fila de subtotal para cada uno. Haz clic en el nivel de outline 2 para colapsar la vista y mostrar solo las filas de subtotal por proveedor. Estos subtotales colapsados representan el monto adeudado por proveedor y alimentarán la plantilla de solicitud de cheque.

Selecciona las filas de subtotal colapsadas. Nuevamente, usa el método Visible Cells Only (Home, Find & Select, Go To Special, Visible Cells Only, Copy) para evitar arrastrar filas de detalle ocultas.

Ve a la primera pestaña del libro (la página de plantilla de solicitud de cheque) y pega. Las fórmulas preconstruidas de la plantilla harán coincidir automáticamente los nombres de proveedor de Citibank con los nombres correctos de proveedor en Oracle. Nota: la plantilla compensa la discrepancia conocida entre "Grainger" (como aparece en el estado de cuenta de Citibank) y "Acklands Grainger" (el nombre usado en Oracle) — no se necesita corrección manual para este proveedor. Actualiza manualmente los siguientes campos: (1) Payment due date — corrígela para reflejar la fecha de pago apropiada del estado de cuenta del mes actual; (2) Statement/document date — actualízala al período actual; (3) Invoice number — ingresa el mes y año justo después del número de factura (por ejemplo, "JAN2026") como referencia de la factura. Usar el formato mes y año asegura una identificación fácil al investigar pagos históricos en el futuro.

Guarda el archivo de plantilla de Excel completado. Luego guarda una copia como PDF (File, Print, formato PDF). La versión PDF es el documento que se enviará para aprobación. También adjunta el estado de cuenta PDF de Citibank (recibido de Chandra en el paso 1) a este paquete PDF, para que el aprobador tenga visibilidad completa del estado de cuenta que respalda los montos de la solicitud de cheque.

Ingresa a DocuSign. Ve a Inbox, Start, Send an Envelope. Carga el PDF de solicitud de cheque completado (con el estado de cuenta de Citibank adjunto). Agrega un título y un breve mensaje al aprobador (Marcello); el aprobador recibe esta solicitud mensualmente y está familiarizado con el proceso. Haz clic en Next. Coloca el campo de firma en el área designada del documento. Haz clic en Send. Monitorea el buzón de DocuSign para el correo de notificación de finalización confirmando que Marcello ha firmado. El proceso de aprobación de la solicitud de cheque está completo una vez que el estado del envelope de DocuSign muestre Completed.

El aprobador recibe esta solicitud mensualmente y está familiarizado con el proceso. Haz clic en Next. Coloca el campo de firma en el área designada del documento. Haz clic en Send. Monitorea el buzón de DocuSign para el correo de notificación de finalización confirmando que Marcello ha firmado. El proceso de aprobación de la solicitud de cheque está completo una vez que el estado del envelope de DocuSign muestre Completed.
Al recibir la notificación de finalización de DocuSign, confirma que la solicitud de cheque firmada se haya guardado.
Envía un correo con el PDF resultante firmado por Marcello adjunto a Anjali Garud, con los comentarios y el número de factura.

Anjali responderá informando cuando el proceso se complete de su lado. Nota: este proceso debe realizarse en los primeros días hábiles del mes. Nota: el proceso transferido desde Wendy es solo para Ghost Cards; los procesos de P-cards y Airfare Cards están a cargo de Moon Lee.

workInstructions.title_es: Apertura y Cierre de Fin de Mes (Canadá)
workInstructions.objective_en: The objective of this Working Instruction is to formally document and standardize the Month‑End Opening and Closing process for Canada. This document serves as a reference guide to ensure consistent execution, clear understanding of responsibilities, and compliance with internal controls when opening and closing Procurement and Accounts Payable periods in Oracle during month‑end activities.
workInstructions.objective_es: El objetivo de esta Instrucción de Trabajo es documentar y estandarizar formalmente el proceso de Apertura y Cierre de Fin de Mes para Canadá. Este documento sirve como guía de referencia para asegurar ejecución consistente y comprensión clara de responsabilidades.
steps_en: Log in to Oracle using the "CA AP Administrator SoD" responsibility, navigate to "Accounting" and select "Control purchasing periods"
Enter the current "Fiscal Year" and click "Go" to display available periods. Locate the next accounting month, select "Open", and "Save" the changes.
In Oracle Java, navigate to "Other" section, select "Change Organization" and choose the first Fcode from the list, click "Ok".
Under "Accounting" section, select "Cost periods".
Select the next month's period and click "Change Status"
Click "Ok" to confirm opening of the cost period.
Click "Save" icon and close the window.
Repeat steps 3 to 7 for all remaining Fcodes.

For closing, Repeat the same steps selecting the previous month and choosing "Close" instead of "Open". Please take into consideration to run a "Transfer journal Entries to GL -- Receiving" request before closing periods.

Once the period is closed, send an email requesting that Procurement period closure be posted in the "Finance Corner" SharePoint calendar. AP period opening and closing can only be initiated after the financial reporting manager confirms that the bank statement reconciliation is complete and that Accounts Payable is authorized to close the period.
Log in to Oracle using the "CA AP Administrator SoD" responsibility, navigate to "Accounting" and select Control Payables periods".
In the new screen, press button "F11", enter the current fiscal year, and execute the query pressing Ctr and F11 buttons.
Locate the new period, click in "Period Status", select "Open" and click "Ok".
Click icon for "Save". Locate the previous period, click in "Period Status", select "close" and click "Ok".
Click icon for "Save", it will pop up an exception click "Ok".
Click "Exceptions" button.
In the decision notice, click "review" to download the final "Period Close Exceptions Report", click "View Output"
Repeat steps 4 to 6. In the decision notice, select "Sweep".
Confirm "Sweep to Period" is showing current open period, select "Submit" and then click "Ok".
Repeat step 4. When the period is closed, it will generate a final "Unaccounted Transactions" report, download by clicking "View Output".
Send an email to AP, T&E, and Reporting teams confirming that the prior period is closed and the new period is open.
steps_es: Ingresa a Oracle usando la responsabilidad "CA AP Administrator SoD", ve a "Accounting" y selecciona "Control purchasing periods".
Ingresa el "Fiscal Year" actual y haz clic en "Go" para mostrar los períodos disponibles. Ubica el próximo mes contable, selecciona "Open", y "Save" los cambios.
En Oracle Java, ve a la sección "Other", selecciona "Change Organization" y elige el primer Fcode de la lista, haz clic en "Ok".
En la sección "Accounting", selecciona "Cost periods".
Selecciona el período del próximo mes y haz clic en "Change Status".
Haz clic en "Ok" para confirmar la apertura del cost period.
Haz clic en el ícono "Save" y cierra la ventana.
Repite los pasos 3 al 7 para todos los Fcodes restantes.

Para el cierre, repite los mismos pasos seleccionando el mes anterior y eligiendo "Close" en lugar de "Open". Ten en cuenta ejecutar una solicitud "Transfer journal Entries to GL -- Receiving" antes de cerrar los períodos.

Una vez cerrado el período, envía un correo solicitando que el cierre del período de Procurement se publique en el calendario de SharePoint "Finance Corner". La apertura y cierre del período de AP solo puede iniciarse después de que el financial reporting manager confirme que la conciliación del estado de cuenta bancario está completa y que Cuentas por Pagar está autorizado a cerrar el período.
Ingresa a Oracle usando la responsabilidad "CA AP Administrator SoD", ve a "Accounting" y selecciona "Control Payables periods".
En la nueva pantalla, presiona el botón "F11", ingresa el fiscal year actual, y ejecuta la consulta presionando los botones Ctrl y F11.
Ubica el nuevo período, haz clic en "Period Status", selecciona "Open" y haz clic en "Ok".
Haz clic en el ícono "Save". Ubica el período anterior, haz clic en "Period Status", selecciona "close" y haz clic en "Ok".
Haz clic en el ícono "Save"; aparecerá una excepción, haz clic en "Ok".
Haz clic en el botón "Exceptions".
En el aviso de decisión, haz clic en "review" para descargar el "Period Close Exceptions Report" final, haz clic en "View Output".
Repite los pasos 4 al 6. En el aviso de decisión, selecciona "Sweep".
Confirma que "Sweep to Period" muestre el período abierto actual, selecciona "Submit" y luego haz clic en "Ok".
Repite el paso 4. Cuando el período esté cerrado, se generará un reporte final "Unaccounted Transactions"; descárgalo haciendo clic en "View Output".
Envía un correo a los equipos de AP, T&E y Reporting confirmando que el período anterior está cerrado y el nuevo período está abierto.

workInstructions.objective_en: The objective of this Working Instruction is to formally document and standardize the process for processing payment registers in Oracle for Canada. This document provides clear guidance to ensure consistent execution, proper authorization, and compliance with internal controls when generating, reviewing, approving, and releasing payment registers.
workInstructions.objective_es: El objetivo de esta Instrucción de Trabajo es documentar y estandarizar formalmente el proceso de procesamiento de registros de pago en Oracle para Canadá. Este documento ofrece una guía clara para asegurar ejecución consistente y autorización adecuada.
steps_en: Log in to Oracle BOSS and access "CA AP User Payment SoD", navigate to "Payments: Entry" section and select "Payments Manager".
Navigate to "Payment Process Requests" tab and select "Submit Single Request".

Enter the "payment Process Request Name" following the established naming convention (CA + payment type/method + date). Then, in the "Use Template" field, search for "CA" and select the appropriate template corresponding to the payment type or method required to run the register (for example, the TCC template). Note: Template list and usage TEMPLATE NAME USAGE CA EFT CAD EFT CA EFT USD CA CHECK CAD Checks CA CHECK USD CA Citibank GHOST 4532 Ghost Cards CA Citibank CHOST 4540 CA WIRE CAD Regular Wires CA WIRE USD CA WIRE AUD CA WIRE GBP CA WIRE EUR CA WIRE ZAR CA TCC CAD Internacional and local TCC CA TCC AUD CA TCC EUR CA TCC GBP CA TCC USD CA TCC ZAR CA TCC USD CORP CA ZERO CAD WIRE Clear zero dollars entering CA WIRE 39086139 USD Debits from Delaware account CA WIRE LAKEFIELD RESEARCH [Debits from Lakefield CAD account]{.mark} CA WIRE RBC USD Royal bank Canada fees CA WIRE RBC CAD.
Navigate to "Payment Attributes" tab and update the "Payment date" as required (actual payment release date).
Update the "Pay Through Date" to ensure all eligible invoices up to the end of the month are included in the register, and click "Submit"
Verify the confirmation notification to ensure the request was submitted successfully. Then, locate the request by filtering on the "Created Date" and click "Go" to display the results.
Once the requests show up, select in "Start action" button.

The system will display all invoices available under the previously selected template. Review the list and remove any invoices not required for payment by selecting them and clicking "Remove from Request". Once the selection is confirmed, click "Submit" to proceed.

If no invoices are available for the required invoice type or payment method, the request may be canceled by clicking "Terminate Request" in the top‑right corner and confirming the action by selecting "Yes" in the warning notification.
After submitting the register, go to Oracle Java (can access through "CA AP User Payment SoD" if needed)
Select window and click "1 Navigator..."
Navigate to "Functions" tab, click "Other" and "Concurrent".
Select "All my requests" and click "Find".
Locate the "Scheduled Payment Selections" in the "Name" field, select the corresponding request, and click "View Output" to download the PDF containing the preliminary payment register.
Verify the information in the PDF match the register created previously.
Send the PDF for approval to the Finance Director with corresponding details.
The Finance Director will reply with the approval For audit purposes, download and save approved "Scheduled_Payment files to G:AccountingAPPayment Registers Chq EFT (or to Ghost card subfolder)
Return to Oracle BOSS, click Clear to refresh the list of registers. Once the registers are displayed, click "Start Action" for the register(s) that have been approved.
Click "Go" on the top-right corner to finalize the approval of the request.
Click "Refresh Status" until the "Payment Process Request Status" shows "Confirmed"

Go to Oracle Java to the "Requests" window, click "refresh data", look by the "Payment instruction register" under Name field, select it and click "View Output" to download the PDF with the preliminary register.
Once the PDF is saved, the invoices are now considered paid.
To send the remittance, click "submit a new request" button. (Do this on payment/valuedate)
Search in "Name" Field, select "SGS Remittance Advice (All)" and click "OK".
In "Payment process request name" field, type the name of the register approved previously. Then, in "Order by" field, select as preferred (for the example, "Paper Document Number") and click "OK"
Select "Submit" button.
Click "refresh data" until the "Phase" field change from "Running" to "Completed".
Select the "Reprint Output" checkbox, enter "SGS Send Mail" in the "Print Style" field, specify the required number of copies, and then click "Apply".
Finally, confirm that the payment notification has been received via email. Note: Acklands Grainger paid by link:
Receive an email from financialservices@grainger.ca containing the payment link, and click "Pay Now" to access the payment portal.
Once the payment page opens, select the Credit Card option, accept the terms and conditions by selecting the corresponding checkbox, and click "Proceed".
Enter the required payment information using the corporate credit card and submit the transaction by clicking "Pay"
Wait for the confirmation message indicating a successful payment, and verify that the transaction confirmation PDF is automatically downloaded for recordkeeping purposes.

workInstructions.objective_en: To establish a standardized, secure, and accurate workflow for applying prepayments to invoices within the Accounts Payable (AP).
workInstructions.objective_es: Establecer un flujo de trabajo estandarizado, seguro y preciso para aplicar anticipos a facturas dentro de Cuentas por Pagar (AP).
steps_en: Go to AP Invoice SoD (Home), select option "Invoices Batches"
Fill in in Batch name the name of the batch and the click in Invoices.

Receive the invoice to process by manual entry (received by personal email) or batch, put the PO and immediately a notification will open, confirming that this PO have a prepayment available to application.
Select pay group: US NAH Citibank.

Click on the icon of "flashlight" to search the invoice to apply the prepayment 6. Entry the Invoice number and click on the button "Find" Note: Final invoice for a prepayment should never be sent to xerox for processing needs to be entered manually so prepayment can be applied. if sent to xerox system might validate it and would not know that an invoice was process and paid. 7. Review that information match between the PDF and the information appears on the system 8. Go to "Actions 1", select the option "Apply/Unapply Prepayment" and click "OK" 9. Check the option "Apply" and click "Apply/Unapply" 10. The new status will be the next one, then close the window: 11. Go to "Actions 1", select "Validate" and click "OK" #.
steps_es: Ir a AP Invoice SoD (Home) y seleccionar la opción "Invoices Batches".
Llenar en Batch Name el nombre del lote y hacer clic en Invoices.

Recibir la factura a procesar por entrada manual (recibida por correo personal) o por lote, colocar el PO; inmediatamente se abrirá una notificación confirmando que ese PO tiene un anticipo disponible para aplicar.
Seleccionar el pay group: US NAH Citibank.

Hacer clic en el ícono de "linterna" para buscar la factura donde se aplicará el anticipo. 6. Ingresar el número de factura y hacer clic en el botón "Find". Nota: la factura final de un anticipo nunca debe enviarse a Xerox para procesamiento; debe ingresarse manualmente para poder aplicar el anticipo. Si se envía a Xerox, el sistema podría validarla sin saber que ya fue procesada y pagada. 7. Verificar que la información coincida entre el PDF y la información que aparece en el sistema. 8. Ir a "Actions 1", seleccionar la opción "Apply/Unapply Prepayment" y hacer clic en "OK". 9. Marcar la opción "Apply" y hacer clic en "Apply/Unapply". 10. El nuevo estado será el siguiente; luego cerrar la ventana. 11. Ir a "Actions 1", seleccionar "Validate" y hacer clic en "OK".

workInstructions.title_es: Registro y Aplicación de Notas de Crédito (Canadá)
workInstructions.objective_en: To provide a standardized procedure for reconciling overbilled quantities and prices by matching supplier-issued Credit Memos against Purchase Orders in Oracle. It ensures financial accuracy by correcting "Price Holds," and overbilling, and validating transactions for final accounting and payment netting.
workInstructions.objective_es: Proporcionar un procedimiento estandarizado para conciliar cantidades y precios sobrefacturados, haciendo match entre las Notas de Crédito emitidas por el proveedor y las Órdenes de Compra en Oracle. Asegura la exactitud financiera al corregir "Price Holds" y sobrefacturación.
steps_en: Go to CA AP User Invoices SoD, Invoices Batches. Then click in batch name. Then this pop-up window will appear.
Fill in in names field: percentage symbol and initials of the name of the badge. (For the example %AB because is going to be made by Arjana Biba) then enter.
In the field "Batch Name" will appear the name of the batch will be filled. Then click in Invoices.

In the column Type select "Credit Memo", in column PO Number fill in the PO Number is going to be charged the credit memo. The fields Supplier, (Supplier # and Site will be filled out automatically) notice in the column Terms for credit memos always be Immediate. Fill in Inv Date, Inv # and then click in Match. The credit memos can be received from the supplier when they want to discount the amount or the price of items. For this case is about invoiced amount.

For this case the PO has overbilled quantity, so the supplier sends a Credit memo to discount from PO. Select the line and the quantity is overbilled. For the example quantity ordered was 2, quantity received was 2, but quantity billed was 4, for that reason supplier sent a Credit memo for those 2 overbilled. To match the quantity Billed, Ordered and Received, for the example in Qty Invoiced fill in (-2) then click in match.
Go to the invoice the Credit Memo was received for and validate. To open the window to validate click on the line of invoice.
Select Validate, then click on OK.
Go to Credit Memo line to open the window to validate click on the line of Credit Memo.
Select Validate, then click on OK.
In this new case is going to be shown how to process a Credit Memo when price is overbilled. Repeat steps 1 to 4. The price billed is 30: The total price is 60 But the price in PO is 27.39.
Go to the invoice, and click in Match.
Select Validate, then click in OK Go to tab 3 Holds, the invoice will appear in On Hold for price.
Create a line in Batch for the difference was overbilled, for this case it will be 5.22 USD. And then go to corrections.
Filling in the original invoice number in the field Invoice Number, then click in Find.
Select the line will be corrected. And correct the items needed to be corrected. For the example, the quantity is 2, the unit price is -30 and correction amount is -5.22. Then click in Correct.
Click in match, select Validate, click in OK.
Select Validate, click in OK.

Verify the terms in Credit Memo and Invoice are the same. In this case the invoice Terms is 60 days, and Credit Memo is Immediately. To correct that select column terms in the invoice will be corrected and change the terms.
steps_es: Ve a CA AP User Invoices SoD, Invoices Batches. Luego haz clic en batch name. Aparecerá esta ventana emergente.
Completa en el campo names: símbolo de porcentaje e iniciales del nombre del usuario. (Para el ejemplo, %AB porque lo va a hacer Arjana Biba) luego presiona enter.
En el campo "Batch Name" aparecerá completado el nombre del batch. Luego haz clic en Invoices.

En la columna Type selecciona "Credit Memo"; en la columna PO Number completa el número de PO al que se le cargará la nota de crédito. Los campos Supplier (Supplier # y Site se completarán automáticamente); observa que en la columna Terms para notas de crédito siempre es Immediate. Completa Inv Date, Inv # y luego haz clic en Match. Las notas de crédito pueden recibirse del proveedor cuando quieren descontar el monto o el precio de los ítems. Para este caso se trata del monto facturado.

Para este caso, el PO tiene una cantidad sobrefacturada, así que el proveedor envía una nota de crédito para descontar del PO. Selecciona la línea; la cantidad está sobrefacturada. Para el ejemplo, la cantidad ordenada fue 2, la cantidad recibida fue 2, pero la cantidad facturada fue 4, por eso el proveedor envió una nota de crédito por esas 2 sobrefacturadas. Para hacer coincidir la cantidad facturada, ordenada y recibida, en el ejemplo, en Qty Invoiced completa (-2), luego haz clic en match.
Ve a la factura para la cual se recibió la nota de crédito y valida. Para abrir la ventana de validación, haz clic en la línea de la factura.
Selecciona Validate, luego haz clic en OK.
Ve a la línea de la nota de crédito; para abrir la ventana de validación haz clic en la línea de la nota de crédito.
Selecciona Validate, luego haz clic en OK.

En este nuevo caso se mostrará cómo procesar una nota de crédito cuando el precio está sobrefacturado. Repite los pasos 1 a 4. El precio facturado es 30: el precio total es 60, pero el precio en el PO es 27.39.
Ve a la factura y haz clic en Match.
Selecciona Validate, luego haz clic en OK. Ve a la pestaña 3 Holds; la factura aparecerá en On Hold por precio.
Crea una línea en el Batch por la diferencia sobrefacturada; para este caso será 5.22 USD. Luego ve a corrections.
Completa el número de factura original en el campo Invoice Number, luego haz clic en Find.

Selecciona la línea que se corregirá y corrige los ítems que necesitan corrección. Para el ejemplo, la cantidad es 2, el precio unitario es -30 y el monto de corrección es -5.22. Luego haz clic en Correct.
Haz clic en match, selecciona Validate, haz clic en OK.
Selecciona Validate, haz clic en OK.

Verifica que los términos en la nota de crédito y en la factura sean iguales. En este caso, los términos de la factura son 60 días, y los de la nota de crédito son Immediately. Para corregir esto, selecciona la columna terms en la factura que se corregirá y cambia los términos.

workInstructions.objective_en: To formally document and standardize the Tax validation process for Canada. This document serves as a reference guide to ensure consistent execution, proper understanding of roles, and adherence to internal controls when processing tax validation.
workInstructions.objective_es: Documentar y estandarizar formalmente el proceso de validación de Impuestos para Canadá. Este documento sirve como guía de referencia para asegurar ejecución consistente, comprensión adecuada de roles y cumplimiento de los controles internos al procesar la validación de impuestos.
steps_en: Go to CA AP User Invoices SoD then go to Invoices Batches.
Click in Show Navigator.
Clic in functions tab, then click in Invoices, finally click in Invoices.
Go to Xerox Report and copy the invoice number.
Paste on Number field, then click in Find.

To add a line to charge the taxes, select the new line and then in column Tupe, select M for Miscellaneous. Tax is not available in the options. Comparison between Oracle register and invoice PDF. When the taxes are entered manually, it is mandatory to introduce the FCode manually. Fcode for Tax: F409701 for SGS Axys Invoices; F400101 for all others.

Click in column "Default Distribution Account" and in the pop-up window introduce the code, finally click in OK. In company introduce F400101, in account introduce: 3652018 or right account depending on taxes is registered. 3652012 -- GST 3652018 -- HST 3652015 -- QST The Inv. Amount and Total Gross Amount must be the same.
Go to tab 1 General, click in Actions.
Select Validate, finally click en OK.
steps_es: Ve a CA AP User Invoices SoD y luego ve a Invoices Batches.
Haz clic en Show Navigator.
Haz clic en la pestaña functions, luego haz clic en Invoices, finalmente haz clic en Invoices.
Ve al reporte de Xerox y copia el número de factura.
Pégalo en el campo Number, luego haz clic en Find.

Para agregar una línea que cargue los impuestos, selecciona la nueva línea y luego en la columna Type selecciona M para Miscellaneous. Tax no está disponible en las opciones. Compara el registro de Oracle con el PDF de la factura. Cuando los impuestos se ingresan manualmente, es obligatorio introducir el FCode manualmente. FCode para Tax: F409701 para facturas de SGS Axys; F400101 para todas las demás.

Haz clic en la columna "Default Distribution Account" y en la ventana emergente introduce el código; finalmente haz clic en OK. En company introduce F400101, en account introduce: 3652018 o la cuenta correcta según el impuesto que se esté registrando. 3652012 -- GST, 3652018 -- HST, 3652015 -- QST. El Inv. Amount y el Total Gross Amount deben ser iguales.
Ve a la pestaña 1 General, haz clic en Actions.
Selecciona Validate, finalmente haz clic en OK.

workInstructions.objective_en: The objective of this Working Instruction is to formally document and standardize the Wire Payments processing procedure for Canada. This document serves as a reference guide to ensure consistent execution, clear understanding of responsibilities, and compliance with internal controls when preparing, approving, booking, and reconciling wire payments in Oracle.
workInstructions.objective_es: El objetivo de esta Instrucción de Trabajo es documentar y estandarizar formalmente el procedimiento de procesamiento de Pagos por Transferencia para Canadá. Este documento sirve como guía de referencia para asegurar ejecución consistente y comprensión clara de responsabilidades.
steps_en: Log in to Oracle, navigate to "CA AP User Payment SoD". Under "Other" section, click "Concurrent"
Run a "SGS AP Ageing Detail By Supplier TEXT (ALL)", do not change any parameters and click "Submit"
Monitor the request until the status shows Completed and Normal, then click "View Output"
Copy all information from text output of the ageing report, go to an Excel and paste the information.
Filter the information or use a pivot table to generate a list with all the invoices validated under payment method "Wire" and due date before the friday of the current week.
Open Java, navigate to "CA AP User Payment SoD". Under "Invoices: Inquiry" section, click "Invoices".
Search one invoice per supplier and open the corresponding PDF.
Save each invoice PDF using the Supplier Name and Invoice Number as the file name.

Open the Citibank Canada Wire Templates Excel file provided by treasury. Search each supplier name to confirm whether an approved payment template exists. If a template does not exist, ensure the invoice copy includes complete banking information.
If a template exists, add a new column in the wire list to record the "Citibank Template Name".
Once all invoices and templates are verified for all suppliers in the list, send the wire proposal email to the Finance Director, copying the treasury team, requesting approval.
When treasury has processed a wire in the bank, debit will show up in the account. Log in TreassuryXpress.
Navigate to "Reporting" and click in "Bank Reports".
In "Bank transactions" tab, filter by applicable dates, and click "Generate".
Scroll down, click the "configuration" icon, click "export to" and click "XLS".
Open XLS file and filter the "Debit/Credit Mark" column to show only Debits (D).

Review the "Description Local Code" and identify the required action per code. Note: List of actions to be taken Description Local Code Action / Book for payment ACH Debit Received Book for payment Book Transfer Debit Book for payment Check Paid No action needed Miscellaneous Debit Book for payment Outgoing Money Transfer Book for payment Preauthorized ACH Debit No action needed.
Verify transaction details in the "Description" column, including payee, invoice number, and currency.

With the payment information, run a wire payment grouping the payments by the "Operation date", "Bank Account Number" and by currency. Run the wire payment in accordance with "EN-Payment Registers Processing-FIN-WI-01-Canada.docx" working instruction. Note: For foreign currencies other than USD, book each payment individually due to exchange rate differences.
Save the final payment register for audit purposes.

To send remittances, open in Java the "concurrent" section to submit a request. Run a "SGS Remittance Advice (All)" report, fill out the "Payment Process Request Name" using the name of the register and click "Ok".
Click "Submit".
Once the report shows as "Completed" and "Normal", click "Reprint/Republish"
Click the checkbox "reprint output".
Choose "Print Style" as "SGS Send Mail", set "Copies" for "1" and click "Apply"
The bank's transaction report will show some auto debited fees with description including "GBL MERCH FEES".
Log in to the Global Payments Portal.
Navigate to "my apps" and click "reporting".
Navigate to "statements", filter by the date and click "apply".
Select all, click "export" and "export" again.
Navigate to "reports" and under "generated reports" section click "download". It will download individual PDFs.
Open the "GL Coding fees (RBC, GLP)" Excel and navigate to "GL Bank fees" worksheet.
Match the transactions using the account number and important information showing in the description of the bank's transactions report and the table available in the "GL Bank fees" worksheet.
Update the columns AA and AB with the corresponding period debited.
Verify that CAD transactions are automatically populated in the top rows of the worksheet and confirm that the corresponding taxes are correctly captured.
For transactions denominated in USD, use the Excel file provided by the AR team to identify and validate the amounts attributed to each business.

Calculate the merchant account usage percentage by business by grouping transactions by "Merchant Number", summing the total amount per merchant, and determining the percentage of total usage attributable to each business.
Using the calculated usage percentages, determine the corresponding portion of the bank fee to be allocated and charged to each business.
Record the allocated fees in column N of the "GBL Bank Fees" worksheet, applying the appropriate GL coding corresponding to each business.
Hide the yellow‑highlighted columns to ensure the final worksheet contains only the relevant information.
Copy the finalized data table from the "Coding" section to the "Inv total" columns, ensuring all calculated amounts, coding and invoice information are accurately reflected.
Paste the table information to the invoice copy.
Request signature approval from treasury director.
Once approved, send invoice copies and coding information to AP to process the invoice in Oracle.
After the invoice entry is completed, execute a regular wire payment following the same booking steps described in the previous sections of this procedure.

workInstructions.objective_en: To establish the standardized procedure for creating support tickets in the Xerox supplier portal when invoice processing errors are identified, ensuring timely correction and accurate documentation of discrepancies.
workInstructions.objective_es: Establecer el procedimiento estandarizado para crear tickets de soporte en el portal de proveedor de Xerox cuando se identifican errores de procesamiento de facturas, asegurando la corrección oportuna y la documentación precisa de las discrepancias.
steps_en: Log in to the Xerox supplier portal using individual user credentials. Note: access to the portal must be requested through the designated SGS Xerox contact and is not managed through internal IT.

Navigate to the Service Catalog section and select the ticket category that corresponds to the type of error identified (e.g., Index Accuracy for data indexing issues such as incorrect supplier name, currency, or banking information).
Select the most specific sub-category available within the chosen category to accurately describe the nature of the issue.

Complete all mandatory fields marked with a red asterisk: barcode label (from the XML document), supplier name (as reflected in Oracle ERP), F code (e.g., CAOUCA OU for Canada), importance level, and reprocessing request (indicate whether reprocessing is required). Enter in description field the description of the case.

Attach a supporting screenshot if applicable, particularly when the error requires visual context for the Xerox team to act on. Submit the ticket. The Xerox help desk will process the request and respond by email. [Ticket Monitoring and Resolution]{.underline} 14. Monitor the AP group email inbox for a response from the Xerox help desk. Responses are typically received within one to two business days. 15. Review the email notification to determine the outcome: closed (action completed), cancelled (with explanation), or pending (with questions or requests for additional information). 16. If the Xerox team requests additional information, respond promptly with the requested details to avoid delays in resolution. 17. If the ticket is cancelled or the response indicates the issue falls outside Xerox's scope, review the explanation and take the appropriate corrective action (e.g., updating supplier master data in Oracle ERP). 18. Confirm that the resolution aligns with the original request. If the issue is not resolved satisfactorily or requires escalation, contact the SGS Xerox representative for further assistance.
steps_es: Ingresa al portal de proveedor de Xerox usando credenciales de usuario individuales. Nota: el acceso al portal debe solicitarse a través del contacto designado de SGS Xerox y no se gestiona a través de IT interno.

Ve a la sección Service Catalog y selecciona la categoría de ticket que corresponda al tipo de error identificado (por ejemplo, Index Accuracy para problemas de indexación de datos como nombre de proveedor, moneda o información bancaria incorrectos).
Selecciona la subcategoría más específica disponible dentro de la categoría elegida para describir con precisión la naturaleza del problema.

Completa todos los campos obligatorios marcados con un asterisco rojo: barcode label (del documento XML), nombre del proveedor (como aparece en Oracle ERP), F code (por ejemplo, CAOUCA OU para Canadá), nivel de importancia, y solicitud de reprocesamiento (indica si se requiere reprocesamiento). Ingresa en el campo description la descripción del caso.

Adjunta una captura de pantalla de soporte si aplica, especialmente cuando el error requiere contexto visual para que el equipo de Xerox pueda actuar. Envía el ticket. El help desk de Xerox procesará la solicitud y responderá por correo. Monitoreo y resolución del ticket. Monitorea el buzón del grupo de AP para una respuesta del help desk de Xerox. Las respuestas normalmente se reciben dentro de uno a dos días hábiles. Revisa la notificación por correo para determinar el resultado: closed (acción completada), cancelled (con explicación), o pending (con preguntas o solicitudes de información adicional). Si el equipo de Xerox solicita información adicional, responde con prontitud con los detalles solicitados para evitar retrasos en la resolución. Si el ticket se cancela o la respuesta indica que el problema está fuera del alcance de Xerox, revisa la explicación y toma la acción correctiva apropiada (por ejemplo, actualizar el master data del proveedor en Oracle ERP). Confirma que la resolución esté alineada con la solicitud original. Si el problema no se resuelve satisfactoriamente o requiere escalación, contacta al representante de SGS Xerox para asistencia adicional.

workInstructions.objective_en: To clearly, orderly, and consistently describe the procedure for performing the three-way match on PO invoices by validating the Purchase Order (PO), receipt, and invoice, and resolving quantity, price, or receipt discrepancies to ensure correct posting to Accounts Payable.
workInstructions.objective_es: Describir de forma clara, ordenada y consistente el procedimiento para realizar el match a 3 vías sobre facturas con PO, validando la Orden de Compra (PO), el recibo y la factura, y resolviendo discrepancias de cantidad, precio o recibo para asegurar el registro correcto.
steps_en: Identify the invoices to verify from the Excel file sent via email.
Go to BOSS (Home).
In BOSS, First, click on the responsibility, then navigate to Invoice Entry and select the Invoice Batches option.
Accept the application opening.
Click Show Navigator.
In Navigator, open the Functions tab.
Open the invoice list on the right-hand side.
Copy the invoice number to verify then enter the invoice number in the corresponding field.
Review the invoice information displayed and Verify PO, invoice name, date, total, subtotal, and taxes.
Click the PDF icon at the top to download the invoice.

If the invoice includes taxes, go to the 2 Lines tab and click on the next empty line, then for taxes such as GST, HST, or QST, select Miscellaneous, enter the tax value, and open Default Distribution Account.

If the invoice includes taxes, navigate to the "2 Lines" tab and click on the next empty line. In the Type field, select "Miscellaneous". Enter the tax value in the Amount field. Then click on "Default Distribution Account" to open the account distribution window. For taxes such as GST, HST, or QST, select the corresponding tax type and enter the applicable account code. Confirm the entry and verify that the distribution is correctly assigned before proceeding to validation.
Once there are no red values in the bottom-left distribution table, go to the Actions menu, select Validate, and click OK to submit the invoice for validation. the invoice is now validated.
Go to General and check Invoices Status. If the status say "Needs Revalidation"
Go to "Holds" Tab, for check the reason of the On Hold.

For this case the On Hold reason is for Qty Rec, that means if the branch did not receive the physical items or the service was not completed or the branch did not receive them in Oracle at the time when the vendor sent the invoice to AP, the invoice will remain in On Hold. This means that the invoice cannot be paid for as long as they do not receive the services or goods in Oracle.

To solve this problem, one option is the following: Go to Lines tab, scroll to the right and in column Requester is registered the name of the person who requested the service or goods. For the example the person is De Guzman Jamila. Oracle automatically sent an email to the Requester to let them know they must receive the goods or services in Oracle. If no, AP could send to them mail to remind them to receive the goods in Oracle.
If nothing matches when opening an invoice, click Match.
Click Find.
Enter the invoice subtotal and click match.
Accept the match and enter the taxes again as previously shown and finally validate the invoice. Go to general, then click actions and in the pop-up window, select validate, and finally ok.
If after matching and validating the status shows Need Revalidation, go to the 3. Holds tab and click Release in case of being a XR Bank/MDM mismatch hold.
In Release Name, select Invoice Quick Release and click OK.
The invoice is now fully validated.
tips_en: A "Qty Rec" hold means the receipt hasn't been recorded in Oracle yet — the invoice can't be paid until the goods or service are received, it isn't a data-entry error.
To follow up, the "Requester" column on the Lines tab identifies who to contact; Oracle emails them automatically, but AP can send a reminder too.
When releasing the hold, select "Invoice Quick Release" specifically under Release Name.

workInstructions.title_es: Proceso de Eliminación de Factura Duplicada (US)
workInstructions.objective_en: The purpose of this working instruction is to define the standardized process for identifying, analysing, resolving, and documenting invoice holds and rejection reports within Oracle. It guarantees proper traceability and documentation of all actions taken to resolve holds and file rejections.
workInstructions.objective_es: El propósito de esta instrucción de trabajo es definir el proceso estandarizado para identificar, analizar, resolver y documentar los holds de factura y reportes de rechazo dentro de Oracle. Garantiza la trazabilidad y documentación adecuada de todas las acciones.
steps_en: First login in Oracle site and the click on "US AP Inquiry" and "Invoices".
Then click on "Invoices", "Inquiry" and "Invoices" in this order.
Go to "view" and click on "Request".
Click on "Submit a New Request".
In name fill "%REJECTION%" and enter.
And click on "Submit".
This report requires some time to be generated. When reviewing the report, apply the filter for duplicates. In column T (INVOICE_NUM), you will find the duplicated invoice number. Column T.
To delete duplicate invoices that have already been processed, navigate to "Open Interface Invoices" in Oracle.
In this section, locate the invoices by pasting the invoice number in the search field.
When you find the duplicate invoice click on "cancel" to delete the information.

And click on "Save". The cancellation of duplicate invoices is performed to mitigate the risk of double payments, ensure financial accuracy, and maintain compliance with internal controls and company policies. This control helps safeguard company funds and supports proper audit traceability.
steps_es: Primero ingresa al sitio de Oracle y haz clic en "US AP Inquiry" e "Invoices".
Luego haz clic en "Invoices", "Inquiry" e "Invoices", en ese orden.
Ve a "view" y haz clic en "Request".
Haz clic en "Submit a New Request".
En name completa "%REJECTION%" y presiona enter.
Y haz clic en "Submit".
Este reporte requiere algo de tiempo para generarse. Al revisar el reporte, aplica el filtro para duplicados. En la columna T (INVOICE_NUM) encontrarás el número de factura duplicada.
Para eliminar facturas duplicadas que ya han sido procesadas, ve a "Open Interface Invoices" en Oracle.
En esta sección, ubica las facturas pegando el número de factura en el campo de búsqueda.
Cuando encuentres la factura duplicada, haz clic en "cancel" para eliminar la información.

Y haz clic en "Save". La cancelación de facturas duplicadas se realiza para mitigar el riesgo de pagos dobles, asegurar la exactitud financiera y mantener el cumplimiento de los controles internos y las políticas de la compañía. Este control ayuda a proteger los fondos de la compañía y respalda una trazabilidad adecuada para auditoría.

workInstructions.objective_en: To establish a standardized process for the daily retrieval, verification, and validation of Local Intercompany invoices issued by SGS affiliate entities within North America. This procedure ensures that all invoices are accurately located in Oracle AP with the correct PO matching, that payment method and affiliate information are properly verified, and that each invoice is fully validated and confirmed in the Oracle system for payment processing.
workInstructions.objective_es: Establecer un proceso estandarizado para la recuperación, verificación y validación diaria de facturas Intercompañía Locales emitidas por entidades afiliadas de SGS dentro de Norteamérica. Este procedimiento asegura que todas las facturas se ubiquen correctamente en Oracle.
steps_en: Invoice Received via Email / Oracle Pending Spreadsheet, download the list of pending invoices from Oracle, Navigate to the Invoices tab under your Responsibilities in Oracle (BOSS Portal - US AP User Invoices SoD).

Search for pending Local Intercompany invoices, In the Find Invoices widget, fill in the Pay Group field with LOCAL-INTERCOMPANY and set the desired Date Range. Set Invoice Status to Never Validated, then click Find.
The query will display all Local Intercompany POs that need to be matched and validated with an invoice.
Open the invoice and verify details, copy the invoice number and paste it in Oracle to search for the related information. Verify that the invoice status shows Never Validated.
Once the invoice information is loaded, open the attached invoice PDF by clicking the PDF icon located on the top toolbar.

Verify the auto-populated information in Oracle against the invoice to confirm there are no discrepancies. The following fields must match: F-Codes, Amount, Currency, Affiliate Name, Supplier Site, and Invoice Number. Payment is always made by check. Note: The Pay Group for Local Intercompany invoices must be set to LOCAL INTERCOMPANY.
Validate the invoice, click on Actions, then select the Validate checkbox, and click OK. Note: When the invoice status changes to Validated, the process is complete. Method 2:
Access the XEROX platform, in the XEROX platform, click on AP Invoices Needs Approval.
Click on the blank checkbox and set the status filter to Never Approved to show only invoices requiring processing. Then download the report by clicking the three dots (...) at the top right corner.
From the dropdown menu, click "Export Data" and wait for the download to complete.

Identify Local Affiliates in the export file, open the downloaded XLSX file and filter to locate Local Affiliates only. Affiliates labeled with NA or North America are the Local Affiliates to process.
Enter Oracle responsibility, click US AP User Invoices SoD, then click Invoices.

Search and validate in Oracle, (the find invoices widget is opened by default when you enter the responsibility in Oracle) copy the invoice number from the export file and paste it in Oracle to search for the related information. Verify that the invoice status is Never Validated.

Open the attached invoice PDF, verify all details (F-Codes, Amount, Currency, Affiliate Name, Supplier Site, Invoice Number), then click Actions, Validate, OK. Note: When the invoice status changes to Validated, the process is complete. Annexes. N/A Attachments. N/A.
steps_es: Factura recibida por correo / hoja de pendientes de Oracle: descarga la lista de facturas pendientes desde Oracle, ve a la pestaña Invoices dentro de tus Responsibilities en Oracle (BOSS Portal - US AP User Invoices SoD).

Busca las facturas Local Intercompany pendientes. En el widget Find Invoices, completa el campo Pay Group con LOCAL-INTERCOMPANY y define el rango de fechas deseado. Establece Invoice Status en Never Validated, luego haz clic en Find.
La consulta mostrará todos los PO de Local Intercompany que necesitan hacer match y validarse con una factura.
Abre la factura y verifica los detalles; copia el número de factura y pégalo en Oracle para buscar la información relacionada. Verifica que el estado de la factura muestre Never Validated.
Una vez cargada la información de la factura, abre el PDF adjunto de la factura haciendo clic en el ícono PDF ubicado en la barra de herramientas superior.

Verifica la información autocompletada en Oracle contra la factura para confirmar que no haya discrepancias. Los siguientes campos deben coincidir: F-Codes, Amount, Currency, Affiliate Name, Supplier Site e Invoice Number. El pago siempre se realiza por cheque. Nota: el Pay Group para facturas Local Intercompany debe ser LOCAL INTERCOMPANY.
Valida la factura: haz clic en Actions, luego selecciona la casilla Validate, y haz clic en OK. Nota: cuando el estado de la factura cambia a Validated, el proceso está completo. Método 2:
Ingresa a la plataforma XEROX; en la plataforma XEROX, haz clic en AP Invoices Needs Approval.

Haz clic en la casilla en blanco y establece el filtro de estado en Never Approved para mostrar solo las facturas que requieren procesamiento. Luego descarga el reporte haciendo clic en los tres puntos (...) en la esquina superior derecha.
En el menú desplegable, haz clic en "Export Data" y espera a que finalice la descarga.

Identifica las Local Affiliates en el archivo exportado; abre el archivo XLSX descargado y filtra para ubicar solo las Local Affiliates. Las afiliadas etiquetadas como NA o North America son las Local Affiliates a procesar.
Ingresa a la responsabilidad de Oracle, haz clic en US AP User Invoices SoD, luego haz clic en Invoices.

Busca y valida en Oracle (el widget find invoices se abre por defecto al ingresar a la responsabilidad en Oracle); copia el número de factura del archivo exportado y pégalo en Oracle para buscar la información relacionada. Verifica que el estado de la factura sea Never Validated.

Abre el PDF adjunto de la factura, verifica todos los detalles (F-Codes, Amount, Currency, Affiliate Name, Supplier Site, Invoice Number), luego haz clic en Actions, Validate, OK. Nota: cuando el estado de la factura cambia a Validated, el proceso está completo. Anexos: N/A. Adjuntos: N/A.

workInstructions.objective_en: Describe the procedure for adding and validating additional charges not included on the main invoice, including freight, miscellaneous charges, and Canadian taxes (GST, HST, QST) during PO invoice processing in Oracle.
workInstructions.objective_es: Describir el procedimiento para agregar y validar cargos adicionales no incluidos en la factura principal, incluyendo flete, cargos varios e impuestos canadienses (GST, HST, QST) durante el procesamiento de facturas con PO en Oracle.
steps_en: Go to CA AP User Invoices SoD then go to Invoices Batches.
Click in Show Navigator.
Click in functions tab, then click in Invoices, finally click in Invoices.
Go to Xerox Report and copy the invoice number.
Paste on Number field, then click in Find.

Open the invoice in Oracle AP and navigate to the "2 Lines" tab. Entry the Taxes (GST/HST/QST); Select the next empty line, Set Type "Miscellaneous", enter the tax amount, Open Default Distribution Account with doble click and enter FCode F400101 and the corresponding tax account and finalize with click in "OK"
The Inv. Amount and Total Gross Amount must be the same.
Enter the freight charge exactly as shown on the invoice.
Click OK in the popup window.If the invoice contains PST (nonrecoverable), add the value and click Allocations.
Confirm that no red fields appear on the distribution table. Go to "Actions 1" select option "Validate" and click "OK" to complete the process.
steps_es: Ve a CA AP User Invoices SoD y luego ve a Invoices Batches.
Haz clic en Show Navigator.
Haz clic en la pestaña functions, luego haz clic en Invoices, finalmente haz clic en Invoices.
Ve al reporte de Xerox y copia el número de factura.
Pégalo en el campo Number, luego haz clic en Find.

Abre la factura en Oracle AP y ve a la pestaña "2 Lines". Ingresa los impuestos (GST/HST/QST); selecciona la siguiente línea vacía, establece Type como "Miscellaneous", ingresa el monto del impuesto, abre Default Distribution Account con doble clic e ingresa el FCode F400101 y la cuenta de impuesto correspondiente, y finaliza haciendo clic en "OK".
El Inv. Amount y el Total Gross Amount deben ser iguales.
Ingresa el cargo de flete exactamente como se muestra en la factura.
Haz clic en OK en la ventana emergente. Si la factura contiene PST (no recuperable), agrega el valor y haz clic en Allocations.
Confirma que no aparezcan campos en rojo en la tabla de distribución. Ve a "Actions 1", selecciona la opción "Validate" y haz clic en "OK" para completar el proceso.

workInstructions.objective_en: To define the standardized process for canceling supplier invoices without a valid purchase order or identified as duplicates in Oracle.
workInstructions.objective_es: Definir el proceso estandarizado para cancelar facturas de proveedor sin una orden de compra válida o identificadas como duplicadas en Oracle.
steps_en: Add to the invoice number "NOPO". (Optional: add more information about the rejection in the "description" column)
Click "actions" button.
Select checkbox "cancel invoices" and click "ok"
Verify status is "cancelled" - Case 2: Cancelation Duplicate Invoices.

When filtering by invoice number, note that there are two invoices with the same Invoice Number, the same Supplier Number, and the same Supplier. Both invoices also share the same date, amount, description, and tax details.
Selecting the first line, the status indicates "Validated," meaning the invoice has already been validated and is ready for the payment process.

Select the other invoice line and verify that it has never been validated. 4. Verify that the PDF for both invoices is identical to confirm a duplicate. To perform this check, click on the first line, select any field within that line, and then choose the "PDF" option.
Select the Invoice Number field of the duplicated invoice. Move it to the end of the last digit or item, and after the final number, append the word "cancel".
Click on the Description field and replace all with "DUP INV"
Select the line to delete and click on the "Actions 1" button.
Select the "cancel invoices" option and click on "OK" button.
In the emergent window click on "OK" button.
Verify the status, it will be "Cancelled"
steps_es: Agrega al número de factura "NOPO". (Opcional: agrega más información sobre el rechazo en la columna "description")
Haz clic en el botón "actions".
Selecciona la casilla "cancel invoices" y haz clic en "ok".
Verifica que el estado sea "cancelled" — Caso 2: Cancelación de Facturas Duplicadas.

Al filtrar por número de factura, observa que hay dos facturas con el mismo número de factura, el mismo número de proveedor y el mismo proveedor. Ambas facturas también comparten la misma fecha, monto, descripción y detalles de impuestos.
Al seleccionar la primera línea, el estado indica "Validated", lo que significa que la factura ya fue validada y está lista para el proceso de pago.

Selecciona la otra línea de factura y verifica que nunca haya sido validada. Verifica que el PDF de ambas facturas sea idéntico para confirmar que se trata de un duplicado. Para realizar esta verificación, haz clic en la primera línea, selecciona cualquier campo dentro de esa línea, y luego elige la opción "PDF".
Selecciona el campo Invoice Number de la factura duplicada. Ubícate al final del último dígito o ítem, y después del número final, agrega la palabra "cancel".
Haz clic en el campo Description y reemplaza todo con "DUP INV".
Selecciona la línea a eliminar y haz clic en el botón "Actions 1".
Selecciona la opción "cancel invoices" y haz clic en el botón "OK".
En la ventana emergente, haz clic en el botón "OK".
Verifica el estado; será "Cancelled".

workInstructions.objective_en: The objective of this manual is to provide a standardized process for reconciling and validating Oracle invoices against POs and vendor PDFs to ensure accurate tax and fee entry for final payment.
workInstructions.objective_es: El objetivo de este manual es proporcionar un proceso estandarizado para conciliar y validar las facturas de Oracle contra los PO y los PDF del proveedor, asegurando el registro preciso de impuestos y cargos para el pago final.
steps_en: The Specialist, Accounts Payable finance -- AP team will send an email every day with an Excel file showing all Oracle invoices never validated.
Go to BOSS open "US AP User Invoices SoD" tab and double click "Invoices" in "Invoices: Entry" ([[Home]{.underl ine}](https://BOSS.sgs.net/OA_HTML/OA.jsp?OAFunc=OANEWHOMEPAGE))
Open the downloaded Java executable file to access Oracle.

Copy the Supplier's "invoice Num" from the Excel, go to Oracle and paste it in the "Invoice" section, in the "Number" field, and click on "Find" button (or any additional information needed (add % to find any ref number that contains the number typed by you)

Verify Status shows "Never Validated" then click on the PDF icon to review the paperwork Note: here are three types of status: needs revalidation, validated, and never validated. - Validated: does not require any action on our part. - Needs revalidation: If the invoice has this status, please go to the "Holds" tab to resolve the issue and continue with validation - Never validated: it is an invoice that has not yet been validated. Please follow the steps below.
Match the following: company name, invoice number, date, $ amount and PO (6 digits)
If the information is correct, click "match" button.
Type the PO number and click "find" button.

Verify that the information displayed in the "Item Description" section matches the information on the invoice. If the information is consistent, select the "Match" checkbox for each corresponding line. Once the line-by-line verification is complete, click "Match" in the bottom-right corner to confirm the operation. Note: There are two PO's types matching, amount-based PO's (Usually services) and quantity- based PO's (Usually products)

If taxes or additional fees must be added, go to the "2 Lines" tab. For taxes, complete the "Tax Classification" column by selecting "Sales Tax" and click "Calculate Tax" to ensure both tax columns match. For additional charges, add a new line as "Freight" when the charge relates to shipping, handling, delivery, ground charges, or fuel; otherwise, add it as "Miscellaneous" for all other types of charges (i. e. Tariff Surcharge), including hazardous material (hazmat) fees or sales taxes when the "Calculate Tax" function is not applicable.

Add any other additional amount stated on the invoice until total amount $ and click "allocations" button (Add additional info to the "description" in capital letters), for the example (FREIGHT) This is another example where the additional charge was "Tariff surcharge". In Description field was added "Tariff Surcharge" in capitals prior to PO.
Make sure the checkbox is checked with the correct line and click "ok"
Once all lines and taxes are added, verify the total amount matches and click "actions" button.
Click the checkbox "validate" and click "ok"
Make sure the status changed to "validated", if not it should show the amount of "holds"
Review the amount of holds and the reasons. If the invoice has no holds, then the process is finished.
Fill out the personal tracker.
steps_es: El Specialist, Accounts Payable Finance -- equipo de AP enviará un correo diariamente con un archivo Excel mostrando todas las facturas de Oracle nunca validadas.
Ve a BOSS, abre la pestaña "US AP User Invoices SoD" y haz doble clic en "Invoices" dentro de "Invoices: Entry" (Home).
Abre el archivo ejecutable de Java descargado para acceder a Oracle.

Copia el "invoice Num" del proveedor desde el Excel, ve a Oracle y pégalo en la sección "Invoice", en el campo "Number", y haz clic en el botón "Find" (o cualquier información adicional necesaria; agrega % para encontrar cualquier número de referencia que contenga el número que escribiste).

Verifica que el Status muestre "Never Validated", luego haz clic en el ícono PDF para revisar la documentación. Nota: existen tres tipos de estado: needs revalidation, validated, y never validated. — Validated: no requiere ninguna acción de nuestra parte. — Needs revalidation: si la factura tiene este estado, ve a la pestaña "Holds" para resolver el problema y continuar con la validación. — Never validated: es una factura que aún no ha sido validada; sigue los pasos a continuación.
Haz match de lo siguiente: nombre de la compañía, número de factura, fecha, monto en $ y PO (6 dígitos).
Si la información es correcta, haz clic en el botón "match".
Escribe el número de PO y haz clic en el botón "find".

Verifica que la información mostrada en la sección "Item Description" coincida con la información de la factura. Si la información es consistente, selecciona la casilla "Match" para cada línea correspondiente. Una vez completada la verificación línea por línea, haz clic en "Match" en la esquina inferior derecha para confirmar la operación. Nota: existen dos tipos de match de PO: por monto (usualmente servicios) y por cantidad (usualmente productos).

Si se deben agregar impuestos o cargos adicionales, ve a la pestaña "2 Lines". Para impuestos, completa la columna "Tax Classification" seleccionando "Sales Tax" y haz clic en "Calculate Tax" para asegurar que ambas columnas de impuestos coincidan. Para cargos adicionales, agrega una nueva línea como "Freight" cuando el cargo esté relacionado con envío, manejo, entrega, cargos terrestres o combustible; de lo contrario, agrégalo como "Miscellaneous" para todos los demás tipos de cargos (por ejemplo, Tariff Surcharge), incluyendo tarifas de materiales peligrosos (hazmat) o impuestos de venta cuando la función "Calculate Tax" no aplique.

Agrega cualquier otro monto adicional indicado en la factura hasta el monto total en $ y haz clic en el botón "allocations" (agrega información adicional al campo "description" en mayúsculas); por ejemplo (FREIGHT). Este es otro ejemplo donde el cargo adicional fue "Tariff surcharge". En el campo Description se agregó "Tariff Surcharge" en mayúsculas antes del PO.
Asegúrate de que la casilla esté marcada en la línea correcta y haz clic en "ok".
Una vez agregadas todas las líneas e impuestos, verifica que el monto total coincida y haz clic en el botón "actions".
Marca la casilla "validate" y haz clic en "ok".
Asegúrate de que el estado haya cambiado a "validated"; si no, debería mostrar el monto de "holds".
Revisa el monto de los holds y los motivos. Si la factura no tiene holds, el proceso ha finalizado.
Completa el tracker personal.
tips_en: Check the status first: "Needs revalidation" → resolve it on the Holds tab; "Never validated" → follow the full process; "Validated" needs no action from you.
There are two PO match types: amount-based (usually services) and quantity-based (usually products) — confirm which one before matching.
For additional charges: use "Freight" only for shipping/handling/fuel; everything else (including hazmat or sales tax when "Calculate Tax" doesn't apply) goes under "Miscellaneous".
Don't forget to fill out the personal tracker after finishing each invoice.
tips_es: Verifica primero el estado: "Needs revalidation" → resuélvelo en la pestaña Holds; "Never validated" → sigue el proceso completo; "Validated" no requiere ninguna acción.
Hay dos tipos de match de PO: por monto (usualmente servicios) y por cantidad (usualmente productos) — confírmalo antes de hacer match.
Para cargos adicionales: usa "Freight" solo si es envío, manejo o combustible; todo lo demás (incluyendo hazmat o sales tax cuando "Calculate Tax" no aplica) va como "Miscellaneous".
No olvides completar el tracker personal al finalizar cada factura.

workInstructions.objective_en: To define the standardized process for manual creation, matching, validation, and documentation of supplier invoices in Oracle.
workInstructions.objective_es: Definir el proceso estandarizado para la creación manual, el match, la validación y la documentación de facturas de proveedor en Oracle.
steps_en: The request is received by email along with the invoice that needs to be validated.

Access Oracle (Home) to verify that the invoice is not already created. Copy the invoice number from the invoice or from the information provided in the email request. Paste the invoice number into the "Invoice" section, under the "Number" field, and click "Find." The system should not display any results for that invoice number.
Go to Oracle and click on the "Window" section in the top bar. From the dropdown menu that appears, select "1 Navigator -- US AP User Invoices SoD."
Click the "+" icon next to Invoices. Then click the "+" icon under Entry and select "Invoice Batches."

In the pop-up window, complete the "Batch Number" field using the following format: first initial of the first name, first initial of the last name, and the date on which the process is performed. Example: CP101225.

In the same pop-up window, scroll to the right until you reach the "Pay Group" column. Click the three-dot icon, then use the "Find" field to search for "LOCAL%." From the results, select "LOCAL SUPPLIERS," and click "OK."
Click on "invoices"
